name: County income and migration from IRS tax returns
description: Individual income tax returns, individuals, adjusted gross income, salaries and wages in every U.S. county for the latest tax year, with the change in income per return from the year before, and the returns and income that moved into and out of each county and state between two filing years, from the IRS Statistics of Income county and migration files. County returns are rounded to the nearest 10 and migration flows are published from 20 returns up; every figure is kept as published, never estimated.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). County income and migration from IRS tax returns (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963195

distribution.name: county-income.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: county-income.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: county-income-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in county-income-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to county-income.csv on id.

recordSet.name: county-income
recordSet.description: The records of County income and migration from IRS tax returns, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id: dataset, place and period

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (DC included), or US for the national record

field.name: level
field.description: county, state or us

field.name: taxYear
field.description: Tax year of the income figures

field.name: migrationYears
field.description: The two filing years the migration flows compare (people who filed in both)

field.name: status
field.description: P: read from the primary source

field.name: returns
field.description: Individual income tax returns filed (the IRS rounds county cells to the nearest 10)

field.name: people
field.description: Individuals on those returns (exemptions)

field.name: agi
field.description: Adjusted gross income of those returns, in dollars (the IRS publishes $ thousands)

field.name: agi_per_return
field.description: agi divided by returns, rounded to whole dollars

field.name: wage_returns
field.description: Returns with salary and wage income

field.name: wages
field.description: Salaries and wages on those returns, in dollars

field.name: wages_per_wage_return
field.description: wages divided by wage_returns, rounded to whole dollars

field.name: returns_prev
field.description: Returns in the previous tax year

field.name: agi_prev
field.description: Adjusted gross income in the previous tax year, in dollars

field.name: agi_per_return_prev
field.description: agi_prev divided by returns_prev

field.name: change_returns_pct
field.description: Percent change in returns from the previous tax year

field.name: change_agi_per_return_pct
field.description: Percent change in AGI per return from the previous tax year

field.name: text
field.description: One plain sentence with the county's income and migration

field.name: value
field.description: Adjusted gross income in dollars (same as agi)

field.name: unit
field.description: What value counts

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the tax year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the tax year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the IRS files were last read

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
